buildings.format: f32 x, f32 y, u16 halfU dm, u16 halfV dm, u16 rot/pi, u16 height dm, u8 class, u8 pad

polys.format: f32 cx, f32 cy, u16 height dm, u8 class, u8 roof, u8 npts, u8 ntri, u16 roofheight cm, npts x (i16 dx, i16 dy) dm, ntri x (u8,u8,u8)

structs.format: f32 x, f32 y, u16 height dm, u16 radius dm, u16 class

rails.format: per way: u8 class, u8 pad, u16 n, then n * (f32 x, f32 y, f32 chainage, u16 offset)

roads.format: per way: u8 class, u8 bridge, u8 lanes, u8 oneway, u16 n, then n * (f32 x, f32 y)
